text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spotted Vodka while out shopping in town.
Next to her was the same junior
she had coached previously.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
With the race coming up so soon...
is it really okay for me to be doing this...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
? What do you mean "doing this"...
It's a change of pace, so ain't it fine?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Because—besides starting dashes, I still have
so many other challenges to tackle!
Speed, stamina... uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop worrying, so I can't relax!
I'm gonna go run around here!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! Hold on—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
Being too serious has its downsides too, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Trainer.
It ain't really that big of a trouble, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I think she understands that when it's time to rest,
you gotta rest properly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I haven't been able
to guide her well...
choice_data_list: What kind of words get through best to you?
What kind of words get through best to you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Me?
Well, obviously Gim-senpai's cool words—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. ...That's it. That's totally it!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, there you are!
Forget about training.
Today we're hanging out! It's a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that! Leave it to "us"!
We're gonna show you a ton of fun!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first up is clothes!!
Let's blow things wide open starting from your look—

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Vodka. That will not reach her heart.
You must sculpt the contours of those unruly words.

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Offer a gentle invitation, like the caress of a feather.
"To set your heart free, you start with your appearance, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm...
It's a rare day off, so you wanna enjoy it, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go bright with your clothes too!
"To set your heart free, you start with your appearance"... how's that sound?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true! In that case...
Maybe I'll buy a brighter one-piece dress!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Next up is the amusement park!!
Let's blow away all the bad stuff and go full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Wait. You must not skip the preparation and approach run.
Are we not soaring into the phantasmal realm together, rather than running solo?

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You must elevate the lamb's spirit—
"I'm having a blast, and so is everyone around us!
No need to hold back!" ...like so.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... you don't come to places like this often, right?
All the other guests look super hyped, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm having a blast, and so is everyone around us!
No need to hold back!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Today...
I'm gonna let loose and have fun with you, Vodka-san!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: Ah~... man, I'm completely exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
But... that was so much fun!
It's been so long since I enjoyed myself this much...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
A change of pace really is important.
Even though I'm tired, I feel ready to give it my all starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Training and rest are entities that complement one another.

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An endless cycle, inseparable twin aspects—
two sides of the same coin, so to speak!
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Training and resting are two halves of the same whole!
Just like two sides of a coin, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How about that? Feeling fully refreshed today, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My mind is totally clear now!
I think I can train with a refreshed head tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both so very much!
I'm going to do my best~!
choice_data_list: ...Were you talking to someone just now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn right!
After all, I've got—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: a guide of destiny by my side!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In this world, there exist secrets
one must never intrude upon—or somethin' like that!

Her unfamiliar tone was curious, but
at any rate, she seemed to have cheered up her junior.
